skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: By the Lamplight
skins.content: 0011 New Arrivals/By the Lamplight. Clothes Surfer wore while sightseeing during the lantern display. A dignified, elegant jacket is draped over an avant-garde red silk top, just like the wearer's cautious exterior hides a daring heart.
skins.quote: She smiles as she says: 'Admiring all these lanterns with you tonight is warmer than the countless sunsets I've seen in the wilds.'
